summary:
Hardening Gate step 2 — DEVICE AUTHENTICATION E2E sign-off. Backend pytest tests/test_device_auth.py: 12/12 PASS in 5.99s (register unique + server-issued, malformed/missing creds → 401 + 'www-authenticate: Bearer' verified via curl HTTP/2, atomic rotation kills old token, revocation is terminal, public /health + /intel/status + POST /devices/register stay public, cross-device_id in path/query/body → 403, family flow with 2 authed devices works, guardian cannot impersonate protected to PATCH progress, stranger sees [] for weekly, legacy device_ids cannot be claimed, expired token → 401 + recovery = fresh identity, concurrent rotation only-one-winner, revoked device never regains access, single-use + expiring guardian confirm token). Frontend E2E on web 390x844 across TWO browser contexts (A protected + B guardian) plus a fresh C for revocation. VERIFIED: (1) onboarding → identity stored in localStorage key 'apollo.device.identity.v2' as JSON {deviceId(32 hex), token(len≥40), expiresAt}. (2) every /api/* request from the app carries 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' (3/3 initial calls checked; 0 401/403 responses during normal use). (3) Cross-device 403: with B's token GET /api/patrol/events?device_id=<A> → 403, PATCH /api/family/incidents/none/progress {device_id:<A>} → 403, POST /api/register-push {user_id:<A>} → 403. (4) No Authorization → GET /api/patrol/events?device_id=<A> → 401 with response header 'www-authenticate: Bearer' (confirmed via curl HTTP/2). (5) Public: GET /api/health 200, GET /api/intel/status 200, POST /api/devices/register 201. (6) Revocation on C: POST /api/devices/revoke → 204, GET /api/devices/me → 401, POST /api/devices/token/rotate → 401 (no restoration). (7) TOKEN ROTATION mid-session (API rotate for A → 200, browser NOT updated) → app dispatches focus → React Query refetches /api/patrol/events & /api/trust → 401 → in-session behaviour is CORRECT: Home shows identity-reset-card with identity-reset-why + identity-reset-register button, localStorage identity cleared, and NO auto POST /api/devices/register fired.

BUG FOUND (HIGH): after the in-session 401 clears the identity, if the tab is RELOADED (page.goto('/') full navigation, F5, or a browser back-forward that remounts the app) the boot code in ApolloContext silently re-registers a brand new device — one POST /api/devices/register fires and identity-reset-card disappears (Home renders 'Apollo is patrolling'). This directly violates the spec 'app must NOT silently re-register' and detaches the install from its family links, shared incidents and push registration without the user's consent. See RCA + fix below.

Minor spec-doc mismatch (not a bug): review request references testID 'family-pair-create'; actual testID in app/family.tsx is 'family-make-code'. The 'Create pairing code' button is present and works — just documented under a different testID. Also there is NO UI button to remove a linked guardian from 'People watching me' (only email guardians can be removed via family-remove-<id>); a LEAVE/REMOVE/REJOIN unlink endpoint does not exist in backend/server.py (no DELETE /api/family/link) — the flow described in step 5 of the review is not implementable through the current UI/API. Regression: Guard tab renders 'Apollo is guarding what he can', Home hero + apollo-state-label render, Settings loads, no console errors.

ui_bugs.issue: After identity-reset, a FULL page reload silently re-registers a new device (fires POST /api/devices/register with no user action), replacing the cleared identity and hiding identity-reset-card. In-session 401 handling is correct; only the boot path is broken.

integration_issues.issue: Spec requires the app to remain in an explicit identity-reset state across reloads until the user taps identity-reset-register. Currently the reset state is in-memory only, so reloading the tab bypasses the gate and issues a new device_id automatically.

action_items: FIX (HIGH): persist an 'identity was reset' flag so page reloads don't silently re-register. In src/auth/deviceIdentity.ts resetDeviceIdentity() also write a marker (e.g. storage.setItem('apollo.device.identity.reset', why)). In src/store/ApolloContext.tsx boot effect (lines 218–225), before calling registerDeviceIdentity() when identity is missing, first read that marker; if present, do NOT auto-register — instead setIdentityReset(reason) and leave deviceId null so Home renders identity-reset-card. reRegisterDevice() must clear the marker on success. This preserves the security property across reloads.

MINOR: review request references testID 'family-pair-create' — actual is 'family-make-code' (Create pairing code button, app/family.tsx:138). Either rename in code for consistency with hardening spec, or update spec doc.

MINOR: The LEAVE/REMOVE/REJOIN step of the review has no UI or backend surface today — 'People watching me' rows in family.tsx have no delete/forget button and backend has no DELETE /api/family/link endpoint. If this flow is in-scope, main agent should add an unlink endpoint + UI row action; otherwise remove it from the hardening checklist.
critical_code_review_comments: src/auth/deviceIdentity.ts is clean: raw token never leaves storage, cached in-module, reset listeners fan out synchronously; the 'reset marker' recommended above is a small additive change and shouldn't disturb existing behaviour.

src/api/client.ts:24–29 correctly calls resetDeviceIdentity() on ANY 401 (both request() and streamPost().onload). Good — Ask Higgins SSE also triggers the identity-reset path if its bearer is rejected.

src/store/ApolloContext.tsx:236–242 handles the in-memory reset state well (setIdentityReset + reRegisterDevice with toast), but lines 218–225 in the boot IIFE unconditionally call registerDeviceIdentity when identity is missing — this is where the reset gate leaks after reload.

backend/server.py device-auth middleware returns proper 'www-authenticate: Bearer' on 401 (confirmed via HTTP/2 curl; my urllib probe missed the header due to dict() collapsing — not a backend defect).

success_rate.frontend: 17/19 assertions PASS; 2 FAIL both from the reload-silently-re-registers bug

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: registered ~5 anonymous devices for auth checks; token rotations, 1 revocation. Backend append-only, no cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Repro (web 390x844, 1 context): (1) onboarding-start-button → disclosure-accept-button → wait apollo-state-label; read localStorage 'apollo.device.identity.v2' (may be JSON-stringified twice) → {deviceId, token, expiresAt}. (2) POST {BASE}/api/devices/token/rotate with 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' (no body needed) → 200. Do NOT update localStorage. (3) Trigger a React Query refetch WITHOUT full navigation: page.evaluate(() => { window.dispatchEvent(new Event('visibilitychange')); window.dispatchEvent(new Event('focus')); }); wait ~5s. Home should show identity-reset-card + identity-reset-why + identity-reset-register; localStorage cleared to null; no POST /api/devices/register during that window. (4) Then page.goto('/') a full reload — currently POST /api/devices/register fires automatically and identity-reset-card is gone. That's the bug. After the fix, the card should still be visible after reload and register should only fire on identity-reset-register tap. Backend WWW-Authenticate header IS returned (curl confirms); urllib's dict(r.headers) can drop it — use requests / raw curl to assert. Backend pytest env: export EXPO_BACKEND_URL=https://threat-patrol-1.preview.emergentagent.com && set -a && source /app/backend/.env && set +a && pytest /app/backend/tests/test_device_auth.py -v.
rca_of_issue: RCA — silent re-register after page reload: on cold boot, /app/frontend/src/store/ApolloContext.tsx lines 218–225 do `if (done) { let identity = await getDeviceIdentity(); if (!identity) identity = await registerDeviceIdentity(API_BASE, deviceMeta()); ... }`. resetDeviceIdentity() (src/auth/deviceIdentity.ts:52–55) only clears in-memory listeners + storage; there's no persistent 'was reset' marker. So on the next page load the boot sees no identity, has no memory of why, and re-registers — exactly the silent path the spec forbids. Fix: (a) in resetDeviceIdentity() write storage.setItem('apollo.device.identity.reset.v1', why). (b) In the boot IIFE, before the missing-identity fallback, read that marker; if present, setIdentityReset(marker) and skip registerDeviceIdentity(). (c) In reRegisterDevice() (line 238–242), storage.removeItem('apollo.device.identity.reset.v1') after successful registration. Post-fix regression: (i) fresh install still auto-registers on completeSetup because there's no marker yet; (ii) in-session 401 still works (already verified); (iii) reload after 401 keeps identity-reset-card visible until the user taps register; (iv) tapping register clears marker + creates new deviceId, /family + Home usable again.
